description: Structural homology search with Foldseek. Searches a CIF or PDB file against PDB/AFDB and ranks hits by TM-score. Can gate struct-predictor: only predict if no close homolog exists.

routes.description: Run the Foldseek demo with the bundled Trp-cage CIF.
Search an existing CIF or PDB file for structural homologs.

input.description: Path to the CIF or PDB file to search

routes.description: Check if the structure is novel using Foldseek before deciding to run struct-predictor. If top TM-score >= 0.9 a known structure exists and prediction is skipped. If top TM-score < 0.9 the structure is novel and struct-predictor is run.
trigger_terms: is it worth running foldseek first

plan.description: Run foldseek first; only run struct-predictor if no near-identical structure exists

steps.label: foldseek_check
steps.comment: Step 1: Search for existing homologs. Produces result.json with top_hit.tmscore.

if_true.label: struct_prediction
if_true.comment: Step 2 (conditional): Predict structure only if no near-identical homolog found.

if_false.text: A near-identical structure already exists in PDB (TM-score {foldseek_check.top_hit.tmscore:.3f} for {foldseek_check.top_hit.target}). Structure prediction skipped — use the existing entry instead.
